newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish fin min in Washington Sept 28 to Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: Finnish fin min in Washington Sept 28 to Oct 3.

text.p: Finland's Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto will travel to Washington on Saturday 28 to participate in the World Bank's annual meeting between October and 3, his secretary said by telephone.
He is due to return to Finland on Thursday, October 3, she said.
The finance ministry said in a statement that Niinisto and a group of senior ministry officials would meet bankers and investors before the World Bank's meeting.
